description: The file 'System.h' defines the interface for the 'IFactories' class within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It declares methods for creating and accessing proxy objects related to web requests, responses, file bodies, and JSON-RPC messages, along with static methods for singleton management and availability checks.

classes.name: IFactories
classes.description: An interface class providing factory methods for creating web-related proxy objects and static methods for singleton access and availability checks.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of IFactories.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether the IFactories instance is available.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy for Web::Request.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy for Web::Response.

methods.name: FileBody
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy for Web::FileBody.

methods.name: JSONRPC
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy for Web::JSONBodyType<Core::JSONRPC::Message>.
